messages:
maria_cs: Quick weekly health check for Acme Corp — focusing on token usage + throughput (QoQ/WoW). Can folks drop any anomalies or actions?

alex_cs: TL;DR — tokens up WoW ~+12%, QoQ flat (-1.5%). Throughput steady but p95 latency creeping up.

sam_eng: noted. p50 ~120ms, p95 last week jumped 220ms -> 260ms on Wed night. I have a trace that shows queueing on model-v2 during the 02:00 UTC batch window.

maria_cs: thanks. Any errors/spikes? spend look ok?

usage-bot: Daily usage summary for Acme: tokens=1,240,532 (+12% WoW), requests=32,100 (+9% WoW), spend=$9,820 (+6% WoW).

jordan_cust: we did a marketing blast Tue which explains the token uptick — some long chat sessions. Not seeing customer-facing errors.

alex_cs: there were 5 transient 5xx on Tue 02:11-02:18 (rate-limited fallback to smaller model), root cause seems to be autoscaler lag on dedicated pool. I opened ENG-4123.

sam_eng: ENG-4123: autoscaler policy for reserved pools wasn't scaling fast enough under burst profile. Temporary mitigation: increased max instances and tightened CPU thresholds. Rolling fix planned for Thursday.

maria_cs: action items then: 1) Confirm ENG-4123 fixes autoscale and post a rollback plan. 2) Validate cost impact of increased instances for Acme (finance cc). 3) Coordinate with Acme CS for a short note about the marketing spike so they don't worry.

alex_cs: will add tests for burst window simulation and post perf numbers in ENG-4123 by EOD Thu.

sam_eng: I'll monitor p95 and queue depth; will post graphs. Quick metrics snippet: 
```
p95_latency: Mon 210ms -> Wed 260ms -> Fri (today) 230ms
queue_depth_peak: Mon 18 -> Wed 46 -> Fri 20
5xx_count_week: 12 (5 in Tue window)
```

maria_cs: great. @jordan_cust can you confirm whether Acme wants a proactive heads-up to end-users? Also add any billing concerns?

jordan_cust: we'll send a short internal note. billing: they said hold budget review until next month but flagged monthly variance — I'll loop finance.

maria_cs: perfect. I'll summarise and send to account thread after eng confirms fix. Thanks all :thumbsup:

usage-bot: Saved note to account-activities/Acme/1772103456
